name: The Eye Of The Behinder
source:
You are the master of a castle. Someone is conspiring against you. However, some servers will support you. A terrible demon can be summoned to confront him.

[From [url=https://enygmage.itch.io/theeyeofthebehinder]tch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一座城堡的主人。有人密谋反对你。但是，有些服务器会支持你。可以召唤一个可怕的恶魔来对抗他。

[来自[url=https://enygmage.itch.io/theeyeofthebehinder]tch.io[/url]]
